## Scope and preservation

- [ ] Historical results, protocols and manifests are not silently replaced.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data or unlicensed third-party artifacts are introduced.
- [ ] Claims match the tests performed; no industrial safety or AI advantage is inferred from a passing check.
- [ ] Rollback is limited to the new change; original observations and failed runs remain available.
